title: View from the ship's porthole of a fiery planet and boxes being loaded

tellings.quote: there was something like a fiery well like a planet giving off heat. And from there they were taking out some kind of cylinders or maybe not cylinders, more like boxes. They were loading those into the ship.

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former president of a republic within Russia, says that in September 1997 he was taken aboard an alien spacecraft. He told podcast host Jesse Michels that through the ship's porthole he saw something like a fiery planet giving off heat. He says beings were taking cylinders, or maybe boxes, from that place and loading them into the ship. If true, it would mean a head of government had direct contact with beings from elsewhere.
